meaning:
1) to thrust, push, drive, cast away, cast out, expel, thrust away
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to thrust, push
1a2) to drive out, thrust out
1a3) to depose

elsewhere.note: If he shoved him out of hatred, or hurled something at him while lying in wait, so that he died,
to thrust out all your enemies from before you, as Yahweh has spoken.
Yahweh your God will thrust them out from before you, and drive them from out of your sight. You shall possess their land, as Yahweh your God spoke to you.
When she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught hold of his feet. Gehazi came near to thrust her away; but the man of God said, “Leave her alone; for…
He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
Yahweh will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.
I will thrust you from your office. You will be pulled down from your station.
Why are your strong ones swept away? They didn’t stand, because Yahweh pushed them.
